reforms.description: The Government announced initiatives to promote innovative activities in Canada, including support for the development of environmental technologies, as part of a broader industrial policy review aimed at redesigning programmes for efficiency in areas such as technology and innovation.
reforms.package_name: 1994 Canadian Innovation and Industrial Policy Review
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Support for environmental technology development can enhance productivity and create new market opportunities in emerging green sectors, supporting long-term economic growth.
reforms.importance_rationale: Announced as part of a broader policy review but described as one initiative among several; no evidence of major structural change or substantial budget allocation.
reforms.source_quote: The Government is taking a number of initiatives to promote innovative activities in Canada, including support to the development of environmental technologies.

reforms.description: The Canadian Investment Fund was announced to work with private partners and the financial sector to identify ways to provide long-term capital to innovative companies, supporting the commercialisation and growth of innovative firms.
reforms.package_name: 1994 Canadian Innovation and Industrial Policy Review
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Long-term capital provision to innovative companies supports commercialisation and scaling of new technologies, enhancing productivity and innovation-driven growth.
reforms.status_evidence: Text states 'The Canadian Investment Fund was announced'.
reforms.importance_rationale: A new dedicated fund for innovative companies represents a significant but focused initiative within the broader policy review; not a system-wide structural change.
reforms.source_quote: The Canadian Investment Fund will work with private partners and the financial sector to identify the best way to provide long-term capital to innovative companies.

reforms.description: The Canadian Technology Network was announced to bring together small firms to design and market globally competitive products, supporting innovation and international competitiveness through collaborative networks.
reforms.package_name: 1994 Canadian Innovation and Industrial Policy Review
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Collaborative networks enabling small firms to design and market competitive products enhance innovation capacity and international competitiveness, supporting productivity growth.
reforms.status_evidence: Text states 'The Canadian Technology Network was announced'.
reforms.importance_rationale: A network initiative supporting small firm collaboration; significant for targeted firms but not a major system-wide reform.
reforms.source_quote: The Canadian Technology Network will bring together small firms to design, and market globally, competitive products.

reforms.description: The government announced measures to enhance job training and support small businesses as part of structural policy reforms to improve economic efficiency and growth potential.
reforms.package_name: 1994 Canadian Innovation and Industrial Policy Review
reforms.component_name: Job Training and Small Business Support
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Enhanced job training builds human capital and workforce skills, while small business support strengthens entrepreneurship and firm-level productivity, both supporting long-term growth.
reforms.importance_rationale: Announced as part of structural reforms but described in general terms without specific programme details or budget allocation; incremental rather than transformative.
reforms.source_quote: it has already taken measures to reform the unemployment-insurance system, enhance job training, support small businesses, and promote technological innovation
